collection.title: BMW Z3 Coupe 1997 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW Z3 Coupe 1997 to 2002 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
